en.title: Satellite Maps
en.summary: Browse satellite imagery with pan and zoom
en.body: Full offline tile cache with support for multiple tile providers. Pan, zoom, and search for locations by name. Tiles are cached locally so you can browse previously-visited areas without a network connection. Ideal for field work, hiking, and off-grid navigation.

pt.title: Mapas por Satelite
pt.summary: Navegue por imagens de satelite com pan e zoom
pt.body: Cache completa de tiles offline com suporte para varios fornecedores de tiles. Navegue, amplie e procure locais por nome. Os tiles sao guardados localmente para que possa consultar areas visitadas anteriormente sem ligacao a rede. Ideal para trabalho de campo, caminhadas e navegacao off-grid.

de.title: Satellitenkarten
de.summary: Satellitenbilder mit Schwenken und Zoomen durchsuchen
de.body: Vollstaendiger Offline-Tile-Cache mit Unterstuetzung fuer mehrere Tile-Anbieter. Schwenken, Zoomen und Ortssuche nach Name. Tiles werden lokal gespeichert, sodass zuvor besuchte Gebiete ohne Netzwerkverbindung durchsucht werden koennen.
